questions.text: What is the shell register map (offset, width, reset value and access of every register)?
questions.default: Offsets 0x00..0x1C direct read of bank registers 0..7, 0x20 CMD_TYPE, 0x24 PARAM1, 0x28 PARAM2, 0x2C GO, 0x30 RESULT, 0x34 RDATA, 0x38 TICK, 0x3C REFUSED, 0x40 TELEM_ON, all 32-bit.
questions.reason: Request names the shell and read-back but gives no offsets, so the map is proposed.
questions.answer:
REFUSED: offset 0x07, WO, reset 0: any write adds one to ERRS
TLM: offset 0x08, RO, reset 0: [0] telemetry on
BANK0..BANK7: offset 0x10, RO, reset 0: the eight registers: ID, SCRATCH0..2, CMDS, ERRS, PERIOD, UPTIME
P1: offset 0x02, RW, reset 0: [31:0] second parameter
TICK: offset 0x06, WO, reset 0: [7:0] added to UPTIME
P0: offset 0x01, RW, reset 0: [15:0] first parameter
CODE: offset 0x04, RO, reset 0: [2:0] result of the last command: 0 OK, 1 unknown type, 3 unknown register, 5 write to a read-only register
RDATA: offset 0x05, RO, reset 0: value of the last successful read, else 0
TYP: offset 0x00, RW, reset 0: [7:0] command type
GO: offset 0x03, WO, reset 0: any write runs the staged command; reads 0
unmapped: an unused offset reads zero and a write to it, or to a read-only register, has no effect

questions.text: Can the write-to-read-only check and unknown-register check overlap?
questions.default: Register number >= 8 gives 3; registers 0,4,5,6,7 give 5 on write.
questions.reason: The two sets do not overlap, so this is a confirmation.
questions.answer: No, they cannot overlap. The spec checks register number first: READ/WRITE with P0 > 7 is refused with code 3. The code 5 rule applies only to WRITE to registers 0 or 4..7, all of which are <= 7 and so pass the code 3 check. A write to a given register number therefore gets either code 3 or code 5, never both. The proposed default matches this: register number >= 8 gives 3; writes to 0, 4, 5, 6, 7 give 5. The spec does not state the ordering explicitly, but the two conditions are disjoint by their definitions, so no precedence rule is needed.
questions.evidence: READ/WRITE need register number P0 <= 7 else code 3; WRITE to 0 or 4..7 code 5
